WITH bio AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
         CASE WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id IN (937368,1119119,19041065) THEN 'TNF inhibitor'
              WHEN anc.ancestor_concept_id = 45774639 THEN 'Gut-selective integrin (vedolizumab)' END AS biologic_class
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor anc ON anc.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_concept_id IN (937368,1119119,19041065,45774639)
), severe_uc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ulcerative colitis%'
    AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%severe%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%acute%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%exacerbation%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%complication%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%rectal hemorrhage%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%toxic megacolon%')
), eligible AS (
  SELECT b.person_id, b.index_date, b.biologic_class,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.person_id ORDER BY b.index_date) AS rn
  FROM bio b
  WHERE b.biologic_class IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM severe_uc s
      WHERE s.person_id = b.person_id
        AND s.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-30,b.index_date) AND b.index_date
    )
), steroid AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS steroid_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor anc ON anc.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept cd ON cd.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_concept_id IN (1551099,1550557,1506270,975125)
    AND LOWER(cd.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%topical%'
    AND LOWER(cd.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%ophthalmic%'
    AND LOWER(cd.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%otic%'
    AND LOWER(cd.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%rectal%'
)
SELECT e.biologic_class,
       COUNT(*) AS index_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM steroid st
          WHERE st.person_id=e.person_id
            AND st.steroid_date > e.index_date
            AND st.steroid_date <= DATEADD(day,60,e.index_date)
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS steroid_rescue_60d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM steroid st
          WHERE st.person_id=e.person_id
            AND st.steroid_date > e.index_date
            AND st.steroid_date <= DATEADD(day,60,e.index_date)
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_steroid_rescue_60d
FROM eligible e
WHERE e.rn=1
GROUP BY e.biologic_class
ORDER BY pct_steroid_rescue_60d

Using the OMOP EHR query with severe/acute/complicated UC proxies and first biologic exposure:

| Biologic class | Index patients | 60-day steroid rescue | Proportion |

**Lower 60-day steroid-rescue proportion: TNF inhibitors** in this dataset.

Biologic rationale: in severe UC, rescue need within 60 days is driven by rapid inflammatory control. TNF blockade directly suppresses a central inflammatory effector axis — TNF-driven macrophage/T-cell activation, endothelial activation, cytokine amplification, epithelial barrier injury, and leukocyte recruitment — and tends to have faster onset in acute severe colitis. Vedolizumab blocks α4β7–MAdCAM-1 gut lymphocyte trafficking, which is gut-selective and safer systemically, but it mainly prevents new gut-homing lymphocyte entry and often has slower induction; it may not rapidly extinguish an already established severe inflammatory infiltrate. That biology supports why TNF inhibitors can show less early steroid rescue.

Caveat: this is an observational EHR estimate using diagnosis-code severity proxies and steroid exposure as a rescue proxy; confounding by indication, prior biologic exposure, inpatient steroid continuation, and treatment sequencing could affect the comparison.
